automationNotes: Runs in the Lytics web app. Doc order: open https://app.lytics.com/, then left nav Data Pipeline → Jobs (`Lytics Job doc: Sidebar navigate Data Pipeline to Jobs`). Optional overrides: LYTICS_APP_URL or LYTICS_APP_ORIGIN for a non-prod app host; LYTICS_PIPELINE_JOBS_URL only if you replace the flow’s first steps with a deep link. Requires a Lytics-authenticated storage state. Job catalog: search "contentstack", Import Entries. Credentials: LYTICS_JOB_STACK_API_KEY / LYTICS_STACK_API_KEY, LYTICS_JOB_DELIVERY_TOKEN / LYTICS_DELIVERY_TOKEN, LYTICS_JOB_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN / LYTICS_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN; LYTICS_STACK_REGION. Headed: npm run test:data-and-insights:lytics-job-auth:headed
